name: self_echo_transcript
description: Muse transcribes the crumb's own voice, reported late: the words repeat the line, so there is no barge-in, the turn is dropped as bot speech, it never counts as a reply, and the follow-up switch still fires.
crumb_text: So what is something you both love doing on the weekends?

turns.text: So I just got back from a climbing trip in Colorado last weekend.
No way, I have always wanted to go climbing out there. Which area?
We were near Boulder, mostly the Flatirons, which honestly have the best views ever.
That sounds amazing, I mostly climb indoors at the gym near campus right now.
Indoor is great for training though, do you boulder or do top rope routes?
Mostly bouldering, my friends dragged me there freshman year and I got hooked.
Same thing happened to me with running, a friend signed me up for a race.
Did you end up liking it or was it pure suffering the whole time?
Honestly both, but now I am training for my first half marathon in March.
That is so cool, what does your training look like on a normal week?

turns.label: C
turns.text: So what is something you both love doing on the weekends?
